title: sambucus latipinna var. miquelii
intro: Sambucus latipinna var. miquelii, commonly known as Japanese elder, is a plant species within the family Adoxaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and infections, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds that provide numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Japanese elder include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which help to alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Sambucus latipinna var. miquelii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sambunigrin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
